result.planSummary: Aligned package publication with Story 4 rules by replacing same-process producer checks with same-project plus bounded package-context eligibility in both Convex and the in-memory store, then expanded coverage to prove mixed-producer publish/review/export and reopened pinned-version reuse.

changedFiles.reason: Updated in-memory package publication validation to allow mixed-producer members only when they belong to the same project and are either current process refs or already pinned in the current package context.
Reworked durable package publication validation to use current process refs and current package-context pins instead of same-process producer ownership.
Refreshed package snapshot tests to cover mixed-producer success, cross-project rejection, and bounded package-context eligibility enforcement.
Added durable package-context coverage for ordered upsert/read behavior, duplicate cleanup, clear behavior, and republishing an earlier pinned version after reopen.
Updated package review API coverage to exercise mixed-producer package members and pinned provenance through the review surface.
Updated export coverage so mixed-producer packages still export pinned contents successfully.
Adjusted integration fixtures to seed current refs before package publication so the stricter Story 4 publish eligibility rule is exercised correctly.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/packageSnapshots.test.ts convex/processPackageContexts.test.ts tests/service/server/package-review-api.test.ts tests/service/server/review-export-api.test.ts tests/integration/review-workspace.test.ts --environment node

findingsFixed: Removed the outdated same-process package publication restriction and enforced same-project plus current-ref/current-package-context eligibility instead.
Added regression coverage for mixed-producer package review/export and for reopened package contexts that keep earlier pinned versions eligible.
Updated integration seeds so durable package publication tests satisfy the story’s stricter bounded-context rules instead of relying on pre-story behavior.

result.recommendedNextStep: Hand off to story verification; the Story gate and Epic gate are both green.
